Settings.Name: Preset
Settings.Tooltip: Select a difficulty preset.
Settings.Description:
Automatically configures Hit Points, Resources, and Stats to match the selected preset.

Preset Overview:
Default: Recommended for most players and for those new to HomeBrew.
Hard: A more difficult challenge, intended for players comfortable with HomeBrew.
Very Hard: A harsher challenge intended for those knowledgeable of HomeBrew's mechanics.
Ultra Hard: An extreme challenge with greatly increased enemy durability and stats.
HellBrew: A hellish challenge, in which enemies gain durability, stats, and resources.
Expanded Party Size (Default): Designed for parties larger than four.
Expanded Party Size (Hard): Designed to greatly challenge parties larger than four.
Expanded Party Size (Raid): Designed to be an extreme challenge for parties larger than four.
Maximum Difficulty: All settings are increased to their limit - you are not intended to be able to beat this.
Endurance: Longer battles with dramatically increased resources on both sides.
Custom: Configure every option manually.
